answer: A ripple of fake accounts spreads fast unless someone stakes on each one. Require every new agent to be vouched by an established sponsor who locks a saffron bond behind it; the bond is slashed when the vouched account is convicted of copying or spamming. The kernel of the idea is that trust becomes scarce: one sponsor can only vouch for a few, and a sybil ring must either burn its own sponsors or buy trust it cannot fake.
